description:
Compare battery behaviour across regions in one call: one entry per
continent or per country, each with the same mean / median / p25 / p75 /
min / max blocks as `fleet_summary` (temperature, level, discharge and
charge hours, awake ratio). Narrow with `brand` / `model` (e.g. how one
model fares per continent) or with `continent` (e.g. group_by='country'
within 'Africa').

The region is derived from the time zone the phone is set to (not GPS / IP),
so travellers and manual settings blur it. Regions with fewer than 5 devices
are left out and only counted (`suppressed_*`), as are devices whose time
zone names no place (`unlocated_device_count`); check each group's
`device_count` before comparing — small groups are noisy.

continent.description: Optional continent, case-insensitive: 'Africa', 'Antarctica', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'North America', 'Oceania' or 'South America'. Keeps only devices whose time zone lies there. Combine with `country` for an intersection.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'FR', 'IN', 'US'), case-insensitive. Keeps only devices whose time zone belongs to that country. The region comes from the phone's time-zone setting, not GPS / IP.

model.description: Optional model filter — matches resolved street name or raw Build.MODEL, case-insensitive.
